measurable success criteria","Target pet species, owner segments, price tier, sales channels, launch markets and languages","Complete SKU matrix, including recipes, flavours, life stages, sizes, fill country-of-origin information","Applicable market-specific pet-food labeling, retailer and accessibility requirements, plus the designated legal or regulatory approver","Pouch construction details, coordinated multi-SKU pouch family.","More than one wet-food SKU is intended, but the number and differentiation dimensions remain unknown.","A common master architecture will connect the range while controlled colour, naming and/or imagery cues distinguish SKUs.","Pouch engineering and food-contact compliance will require approval from the converter or qualified packaging specialist; the designer will not independently certify manufacturing fitness.","The client will supply or formally approve product data, regulatory copy, claims substantiation, barcodes and legal translations.","Final delivery means validated digital identity and packaging assets; printing, filling and commercial manufacture are performed by appointed vendors.","The reference is treated only as visible published-outcome evidence of a coordinated packaging family and will not determine the pet-food brand's aesthetic, content or structure."],"stop_conditions":["Do not begin substantive concept exploration until brand ownership, audience, positioning, launch market and initial SKU scope are confirmed.","Do not finalize pouch layouts without confirmed dimensions, construction, processing requirements and converter-approved technical geometry.","Do not expand the selected design across the range without explicit written direction approval and a controlled SKU-content matrix.","Do not release production files until all mandatory pet-food copy, translations, claims and regulatory content have been approved by the responsible client or specialist.","Stop production release if prototypes or proofs reveal inadequate legibility, weak SKU distinction, seal-zone conflicts, barcode failure, colour problems or material and processing incompatibility.","Do not deliver final masters while barcodes, licenses, linked assets, fonts, proof approvals or converter preflight acceptance remain unresolved.","Re-scope before proceeding if approved structure, SKU count, markets, print method or core brand direction changes materially."],"rationale":"The brief is classified as concept_to_production because it spans strategy and identity creation, packaging architecture, The published reference supports only the observable idea of a coherent package family using repeated brand elements and visible variation; it supplies no pet-food strategy, aesthetic mandate, dieline or manufacturing evidence.","confidence":0.94}
